record.paper_title: Open problems in deformations of Artinian algebras, Hilbert schemes and around
record.original_question: Produce a small example of a disconnected multigraded Hilbert scheme, preferably one whose Hilbert function is eventually constant.

evidence.quote: Problem XXXIV. Give a “small” example of a disconnected multigraded Hilbert scheme, preferably with Hr eventually constant.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field and let $S = k[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ be a polynomial ring graded by an abelian group $A$ via a degree function $\deg : \{x_1,\ldots,x_n\} \to A$. For a function $h : A \to \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$, the multigraded Hilbert scheme $H^h_S$ parametrizes homogeneous ideals $I \subset S$ such that, for every $a \in A$, the graded piece $(S/I)_a$ is a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space of dimension $h(a)$. By a theorem of Haiman and Sturmfels, $H^h_S$ exists as a quasi-projective scheme over $k$ (projective when each $S_a$ is finite-dimensional).

Exhibit an explicit example, of as small size as possible (small $n$, simple grading group $A$, and small values of $h$), of a triple $(S, A\text{-grading}, h)$ for which the resulting multigraded Hilbert scheme $H^h_S$ is disconnected. Preferably, the example should have the property that the Hilbert function $h$ is eventually constant (i.e., there is a finitely generated submonoid containing the degrees, on which $h$ takes a constant value outside a finite set).
artifact.status_search_result: Multigraded Hilbert schemes (Haiman–Sturmfels) are known to be disconnected in general; toric Hilbert schemes are suspected to be disconnected via flip-graph constructions (Hering–Maclagan and others). However, no published small explicit example with $h$ eventually constant could be confirmed from the available sources, and the problem appears to remain a request for a concrete small example.

status_evidence.title: Multigraded Hilbert Schemes (Haiman–Sturmfels)
status_evidence.snippet: Foundational paper constructing multigraded Hilbert schemes parametrizing ideals with given Hilbert function under an abelian grading.
status_evidence.claim: Defines the scheme in question; provides framework for connectedness questions.

status_evidence.title: The T-graph of a multigraded Hilbert scheme (Hering–Maclagan)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the T-graph whose connectedness controls connectedness of multigraded Hilbert schemes; gives evidence for disconnected examples in toric setting.
status_evidence.claim: Disconnectedness phenomena are studied but explicit small examples with eventually constant Hilbert function are not standard.
